title: Young people have limited opportunities to practise job interviews and get individualised feedback before applying for an apprenticeship or first job, and teachers cannot provide repeated one-to-one training at scale. The challenge is to create a natural, realistic conversational interview experience that adapts to the student, evaluates their answers, and gives constructive, development-oriented feedback.
